text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Can Twin Turbo hold on to the very end?! 
The Nakayama homestretch is short!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uggghhh, it's not that shoooooort! Even 
sooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Dyaaaaaaaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: How's thaaaaaaat?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo claimed victory with everything 
she had, and then—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo's... outta gas... Ugyuuuuuu...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—They passed out. It was truly a run where 
they gave it 1000% of their power.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was quite a while later when the 
collapsed Twin Turbo finally woke up.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh? Trainer... What's the matter, Turbo?
choice_data_list: I collapsed right after winning, you know.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
“I see... Turbo doesn't remember anything 
past a certain point...”

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Still, Turbo won, right?! I took the 
Satsuki Sho, didn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
WE DID IT WE DID IT WE DID IT WE DID IT 
YAAAYYYYY!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: How's that, Tokai Teio?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "She's not here??? Why???"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, that's right~. I can't really boast 
like this~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, there was no triumphant 
pride to be had. Even so, the glory 
remained real. And then...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, giving it my all today felt so, so 
good!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly like this! This is how Turbo 
wants to run!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama, huh. The final stretch wasn't as 
short as they say, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo likes Nakayama a little better now! 
Turbo and Nakayama might be totally 
compatible!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Next time I run, and the time after that, 
I'm gonna whip up a Turbo whirlwind!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A blazing fireball victory, burning 
herself out entirely. With that, Twin 
Turbo gained confidence at Nakayama 
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had a feeling that we would continue to 
create countless miracles right here in 
this place.
